concepts.title: Present Perfect Tense: Fill the Blank
concepts.definition: The present perfect (has or have + third form of the verb) shows an action completed in the recent past or continuing into the present, often with already, just, twice, since.
concepts.key_idea: The time is unfinished or unstated - that is why has or have + V3, not the simple past.
question_patterns: Fill in the blank with the present perfect form of the verb
Choose has or have with the third verb form
Complete the sentence in the present perfect tense

solution_steps.explain: write the past participle: finish -> finished, give -> given
already, just, twice, since fit the present perfect

worked_examples.q: Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: She ___ her homework already. (finish)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: They ___ the museum twice. (visit)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: I ___ this novel many times. (read)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: Rahul ___ his keys. (lose)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: We ___ in this town since 2015. (live)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: The train ___ the station just now. (leave)
Fill in the blank with the present perfect form: My parents ___ me a gift. (give)

concepts.title: Active to Passive Voice: Present Simple
concepts.definition: In the passive voice the object of the active sentence becomes the subject. For the present simple the verb is is, am or are + third form; the doer follows by.
concepts.formula: active: A does X  ->  passive: X is/are done by A
concepts.key_idea: Present simple passive = is/am/are + V3 (+ by + doer).
question_patterns: Change the sentence into the passive voice
Fill the passive verb form in the blank
Rewrite the active sentence in the passive

solution_steps.explain: the active object starts the passive sentence
match the new singular or plural subject

worked_examples.q: Change into the passive voice: Riya writes a letter. - A letter ___ by Riya. (write)
Change into the passive voice: The chef cooks dinner. - Dinner ___ by the chef. (cook)
Change into the passive voice: They clean the classroom daily. - The classroom ___ daily. (clean)
Change into the passive voice: Sohan plays chess. - Chess ___ by Sohan. (play)
Change into the passive voice: The gardener waters the plants. - The plants ___ by the gardener. (water)
Change into the passive voice: Everyone loves the puppy. - The puppy ___ by everyone. (love)
Change into the passive voice: The company sells cars. - Cars ___ by the company. (sell)

concepts.title: Correct Spelling: Choose the Right Word
concepts.definition: Four spellings of one word are given; only one is correct. Common traps: ie and ei, double letters, and -able versus -eable endings.
concepts.formula: i before e except after c: believe, receive
concepts.key_idea: Say the word in syllables and count the double letters.
question_patterns: Choose the correctly spelled word from the four options
Pick the right spelling of the word
Which option spells the word correctly?

solution_steps.explain: believe has ie, receive has ei after c
necessary has one c and two s
